arxiv-2104-14411.title: Transmission of electromagnetic waves through nonlinear optical layers
arxiv-2104-14411.creator: L. M. Hincapie-Zuluaga, J. D. Mazo-Vásquez, C. A. Betancur-Silvera, and E. Reyes-Gómez
arxiv-2104-14411.description: Abstract The excitation of soliton states in optical layers exhibiting Kerr nonlinearities is theoretically investigated. The optical transmission coefficient is obtained as a function of the intensity of an incident light beam. The incident electromagnetic wave is considered to be monochromatic and linearly polarized in the transverse electric configuration.

arxiv-2204-12313.title: Reconstruction of decays to merged photons using end-to-end deep learning with domain continuation in the CMS detector
arxiv-2204-12313.description: Abstract A novel technique based on machine learning is introduced to reconstruct the decays of highly Lorentz-boosted particles. Using an end-to-end deep learning strategy, the technique bypasses existing rule-based particle reconstruction methods typically used in high energy physics analyses. It uses minimally processed detector data as input and directly outputs particle properties of interest.

arxiv-2310-15457.title: An Iteratively Decoupled Algorithm for Multiple-Network Poroelastic Model with Applications in Brain Flow Simulations
arxiv-2310-15457.creator: Mingchao Cai, Meng Lei, Jingzhi Li, Jiaao Sun, Feng Wang
arxiv-2310-15457.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mingchao Cai, Meng Lei, Jingzhi Li, Jiaao Sun, Feng Wang. In this work, we present an iteratively decoupled algorithm for solving the quasi-static multiple-network poroelastic model. Our approach employs a total-pressure-based formulation with solid displacement, total pressure, and network pressures as primary unknowns. This reformulation decomposes the original problem into a generalized Stokes problem and a parabolic problem, offering key advantages such as reduced elastic locking effects and simplified discretization. The algorithm guarantees unconditional convergence to the solution of the fully coupled system.

arxiv-2406-02572.title: Self-supervised Learning for Pathological Speech Detection
arxiv-2406-02572.creator: Shakeel A. Sheikh
arxiv-2406-02572.description: Abstract Speech production is a complex phenomenon, wherein the brain orchestrates a sequence of processes involving thought processing, motor planning, and the execution of articulatory movements. However, this intricate execution of various processes is susceptible to influence and disruption by various neurodegenerative pathological speech disorders, such as Parkinson’s disease, resulting in dysarthria, apraxia, and other conditions.

arxiv-2502-13030.title: Conformal Inference under High-Dimensional Covariate Shifts via Likelihood-Ratio Regularization
arxiv-2502-13030.creator: Sunay Joshi, Shayan Kiyani, Edgar Dobriban, Hamed Hassani
arxiv-2502-13030.description: Abstract We consider the problem of conformal prediction under covariate shift. Given labeled data from a source domain and unlabeled data from a covariate shifted target domain, we seek to construct prediction sets with valid marginal coverage in the target domain.

arxiv-2502-14156.title: Mixed Signals: A Diverse Point Cloud Dataset for Heterogeneous LiDAR V2X Collaboration
arxiv-2502-14156.creator: Katie Z Luo Minh-Quan Dao Zhenzhen Liu Mark Campbell Wei-Lun Chao Kilian Q Weinberger, Ezio Malis Vincent Frémont Bharath Hariharan Mao Shan Stewart Worrall Julie Stephany Berrio Perez
arxiv-2502-14156.description: Abstract Vehicle-to-everything (V2X) collaborative perception has emerged as a promising solution to address the limitations of single-vehicle perception systems. However, existing V2X datasets are limited in scope, diversity, and quality. To address these gaps, we present Mixed Signals, a comprehensive V2X dataset featuring 45.1k point clouds and 240.

arxiv-2506-16536.title: Enumeration of Virtual Quandles
arxiv-2506-16536.description: Abstract Virtual racks and virtual quandles are nonassociative algebraic structures based on the Reidemeister moves of virtual knots. In this note, we enumerate virtual dihedral quandles and several families of virtual permutation racks and virtual conjugation quandles up to isomorphism. We also classify virtual racks and virtual quandles up to order 8 8 using a computer search.

arxiv-2512-05485.title: TeleAI-Safety: A comprehensive LLM jailbreaking benchmark towards attacks, defenses, and evaluations Journal: Pattern Recognition
arxiv-2512-05485.creator: Xiuyuan Chen, Jian Zhao, Yuxiang He, Yuan Xun, Xinwei Liu, Yanshu Li, Huilin Zhou, Wei Cai, Ziyan Shi, Yuchen Yuan, Tianle Zhang, Chi Zhang, Xuelong Li
arxiv-2512-05485.description: Abstract While the deployment of large language models (LLMs) in high-value industries continues to expand, the systematic assessment of their safety against jailbreak and prompt-based attacks remains insufficient. Existing safety evaluation benchmarks and frameworks are often limited by an imbalanced integration of core components (attack, defense, and evaluation methods) and an isolation between flexible evaluation frameworks and standardized benchmarking capabilities.

pmc-10661823.title: Cardiovascular safety of psychedelic medicine: current status and future directions
pmc-10661823.creator: Agnieszka Wsół
pmc-10661823.description: Psychedelics are powerful psychoactive substances that alter perception and mood processes. Their effectiveness in the treatment of psychiatric diseases was known before their prohibition. An increasing number of recent studies, due to the indisputable resurgence of serotonergic hallucinogens, have shown their efficacy in alleviating depression, anxiety, substance abuse therapies, and existential distress treatment in patients facing life-threatening illness.

pmc-11565027.title: A dataset revolutionizing Indian bay leaf analysis
pmc-11565027.creator: Priyanka Paygude, Sandip Thite, Ajay Kumar, Amol Bhosle, Rajendra Pawar, Renuka Mane, Rahul Joshi, Manisha Kasar, Prashant Chavan, Milind Gayakwad
pmc-11565027.description: Indian bay leaf is a crucial spice in Indian cuisine. However, its quality and authenticity are often compromised. To address this, we introduce The Digital Indian Bay leaf dataset, a comprehensive collection of high-resolution 5696 images capturing diverse bay leaf samples under controlled conditions.

pmc-11602681.title: Who Said What? The Effects of Cognitive Load on Source Monitoring and Memory for Multiple witnesses' Accounts
pmc-11602681.creator: Pamela Hanway, Lucy Akehurst, Zarah Vernham, Lorraine Hope
pmc-11602681.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Investigative interviewers are often required to accurately remember information that has been provided by different people. This can be at the scene of an event or during follow‐up investigations in interview rooms. Interviewers must accurately monitor the source of information to differentiate between witnesses' accounts and to assess what information is novel and what has been corroborated by others or by physical evidence.

pmc-11629145.title: Ultrasensitive detection of antimicrobial resistance genes using hybridization chain reaction employing carbon dots†
pmc-11629145.creator: Harshil Thakkar, Sonal Thakore, Manoj Baghel, Sanjay Kosara, Heli Upadhyaya, Hemanta Chalan, Devarshi Gajjar
pmc-11629145.description: One of the top 10 global concerns include AntiMicrobial Resistance (AMR), which warrants the need to develop materials and methods for detection of AMR genes. Here, we propose a proof-of-concept approach for selective and ultrasensitive detection of AMR gene employing fluorescent carbon dots.

pmc-12413530.title: Greater Personal Health Agency Is Associated With Greater Patient Receptiveness to Mindset Exercises
pmc-12413530.creator: Niels Brinkman, Rebecca Ludden, Ali Azarpey, Job N Doornberg, David Ring, Prakash Jayakumar
pmc-12413530.description: Among 203 patients presenting for musculoskeletal specialty care between November 2023 and January 2024, we measured the relationship of openness to mindset exercises such as cognitive behavioral therapy (training the mind to default to healthier thoughts and feelings about bodily sensations) with levels of personal health agency accounting for other personal factors.

pmc-12548281.title: Identification of microprotein-coding intronic polyadenylation isoforms and function in genotoxic anticancer drug response

pmc-12564522.title: Genetic Diversity of Fresh Maize Germplasm Revealed by Morphological Traits and SSR Markers
pmc-12564522.creator: Suying Guo, Xin Zheng, Shuaiyi Wang, Yuran Ai, Rengui Zhao, Jinhao Lan
pmc-12564522.description: Background: This study aims to systematically evaluate the genetic divergence among 200 fresh maize inbred lines using both phenotypic and molecular markers, and to compare the efficacy of these two approaches for genetic classification. Methods: Phenotypic clustering analysis was conducted based on eight key agronomic traits, including plant height and ear length.

pmc-12635165.title: MU-Glioma Post: A comprehensive dataset of automated MR multi-sequence segmentation and clinical features
pmc-12635165.creator: Esmat Mahmoud, Jaime Gass, Yaseen Dhemesh, Josh Greaser, Karolina Pogorzelski, Edvin Isufi, Filip Garrett, Jonathan Thacker, Nourel hoda Tahon, Jason Sinclair, Lester Layfield, Talissa Altes, Ayman Nada
pmc-12635165.description: Gliomas represent a heterogenous group of primary brain tumors with overlapping imaging phenotypes. Treatment typically includes surgery and/or chemoradiation, however this varies based on the overall lesion and clinical presentation. This heterogeneity in both lesion characteristics and management strategies contributes to a lack of reliable findings when evaluating treatment outcomes with conventional MRI.

pmc-13565586.creator: Lei Zhang, Guobo Sun, Rui Zhu, Gansheng Zhang, Qingyi Zhou, Yue Wang, Xiujun Duan
